title: SimpleTexting vs EZ Texting (2026): Which Is Actually Cheaper?

facts.fact: EZ Texting's starting price is $20 per month.
facts.quote: EZ Texting starts at $20 a month. SimpleTexting starts at $29.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting's starting price is $29 per month.
facts.quote: EZ Texting starts at $20 a month. SimpleTexting starts at $29.

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Launch plan costs $20 per month at annual billing and covers up to 500 contacts.
facts.quote: | Launch | **$20/mo** | Up to 500 | 6,000/year | 1 |

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Boost plan costs $60 per month at annual billing and covers 500 to 2,000 contacts.
EZ Texting's Scale plan costs $100 per month at annual billing and covers 2,000 to 50,000 contacts.
EZ Texting's Enterprise plan starts at $3,000 per month for 50,000+ contacts, with 200,000 credits per month.
facts.quote: | Enterprise | **From $3,000/mo** | 50,000+ | 200,000/month | Custom |

facts.fact: EZ Texting advertises up to 20% off its plans for annual payment.
facts.quote: EZ Texting advertises up to 20% off for paying yearly.

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Launch, Boost and Scale plans each include 6,000 credits per year, not per month.
facts.quote: EZ Texting’s Launch, Boost and Scale plans all include **6,000 credits per year**. Not per month.

facts.fact: EZ Texting charges overage per message of 4 cents on Launch, 3.5 cents on Boost, 3 cents on Scale, and 1 cent on Enterprise.
facts.quote: EZ Texting charges overage per message: 4 cents on Launch, 3.5 cents on Boost, 3 cents on Scale, and 1 cent on Enterprise.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting's entry tier is 500 credits at $29 per month on a toll-free number.
facts.quote: That entry tier is **500 credits at $29 a month on a toll-free number**.

facts.fact: On SimpleTexting, a local number raises the entry tier to $39 per month plus a one-time $4 carrier registration fee.
facts.quote: A local number instead makes it $39 and adds a one-time $4 carrier registration fee that toll-free skips.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting's top tier is 50,000 credits per month at $899 per month, or 1.8 cents per message.
SimpleTexting offers 20% off for yearly payment and 15% off for nonprofits.
facts.quote: Paying yearly saves 20%, and nonprofits get 15% off.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting includes unlimited contacts on every tier.
facts.quote: **Contacts are unlimited on every tier**, no matter which one you are on

facts.fact: SimpleTexting unused credits roll over to the end of the following month.
facts.quote: unused credits roll over to the end of the following month.

facts.fact: On SimpleTexting, a standard SMS up to 160 characters uses 1 credit, an extended message up to 306 characters uses 2 credits, and an MMS uses 3 credits.
facts.quote: One SMS up to 160 characters is one credit, an extended message up to 306 characters is 2, and an MMS is 3.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting includes 3 users, with extra users costing $20 per month each.
facts.quote: | Users included | **3** (extra $20/mo) | 1 on Launch, Boost, Scale |

facts.fact: SimpleTexting offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.
facts.quote: | Free trial | **14 days, no card** | Not published |

facts.fact: SimpleTexting offers a 30-day money-back guarantee.
facts.quote: | Money-back | 30 days | Not published |

facts.fact: ClickSend's listed price is $29 per month, and the publisher states its totals include a roughly 0.42 cent per-message carrier fee.
facts.quote: ClickSend and SimpleTexting totals include their roughly 0.42 cent per-message carrier fee

facts.fact: Mobile Text Alerts' listed price is $44 per month, and its free trial includes 50 texts and a dedicated toll-free number for 14 days.
facts.quote: Free 14-day trial with 50 texts and a dedicated toll-free number.
